finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the attacker can control the wordlist_path and it points to a crafted file or directory name that includes shell metacharacters or control operators, it could lead to command injection.
finding.assumptions: The function `fopen` is used to open the file, and the path provided by the user is directly used without any validation or sanitization.
